QUOTE: resolves the `.so` from `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/`, then `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives env overrides, then ~/.entropic, then find_library, but it attaches the two layouts only to `$ENTROPIC_HOME`, not to every root. It also never calls find_library the system library cache.
